name: Don't Press The Button Furious Jumper
desc:
🎮 Don't Press The Button Furious Jumper - Embark on an Adventure!

🔥 Will you dare to press the button? 🔥
In this game full of surprises and twists, pressing the button triggers unexpected events! Each press can lead to hilarious moments, intense challenges, or... put you in a tricky situation.

💰 Collect coins: Gather and earn coins to buy accessories! 

🚀 70 stages available, with more to come!

⚠️ The game is in beta: Some bugs may occur! Thank you for your support and understanding.

🔧 Developer: JasonAmg54
